entries.title: I Peter 4:1
segments: With the same mind. Most probably this means, Look on suffering as Christ did, who was made perfect through suffering (

).
 

 
 He that hath suffered in the flesh hath ceased from sin. This teaches the moral value of suffering, in that those who have fellowship with Christ's suffering are weaned from the love of sin.

entries.title: I Peter 4:7
segments: The end of all things is at hand. This refers to the second coming of Christ.

entries.title: I Peter 4:10
segments: A gift. Probably some gift of the Spirit. See

entries.title: I Peter 4:12
segments: The fiery trial Imminent persecution because of their faith in Christ.

entries.title: I Peter 4:17
segments: For judgment to begin at the house of God. The sufferings of persecuted Christians were the beginning of judgment.
